ns2:course.label: Health and Wellness in Literature
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in the Health & Wellness pathway. Exploration of creative, literary responses to the issue of Health & Wellness from an interdisciplinary perspective with an emphasis on experiential learning. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Health/Well, and Humanities - Lit & Arts course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
